result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue in the bottom navigation bar where missing safe-area padding causes overlap with the system home indicator.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar lacks bottom safe-area padding, causing the system home indicator pill to directly overlap the search and orders icons while pushing all navigation icons flush against the bottom edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area inset padding (e.g., env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) to the bottom navigation container so the icons sit cleanly above the system gesture bar.
